question: What native contract should OpenClaw use when a child session crosses context pressure: observe-only diagnostics, parent/operator notification, or automatic recovery routing?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but thresholds, parent identity, alert target, and recovery behavior are product/API choices rather than a safe one-file bug fix.

options.title: Add observe-only diagnostics first
options.body: Emit a native context-pressure diagnostic for saturated sessions and require a follow-up decision before parent routing or automatic recovery.

options.title: Notify parent and operator
options.body: Define a parent/operator notification target and deliver alerts when child sessions cross a chosen threshold.

options.title: Add automatic recovery routing
options.body: Let OpenClaw trigger recovery or alternate-specialist routing, accepting a larger orchestration-policy surface.

recommendation.title: Add observe-only diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Emit a native context-pressure diagnostic for saturated sessions and require a follow-up decision before parent routing or automatic recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available decision owner from the history signals because this is a product-direction choice across session health, subagent routing, and VISION.md orchestration guardrails.
